statement: Shakata Yoga (the Moon in the 6th, 8th, or 12th house from Jupiter, and not itself angular from the Ascendant) is traditionally read as carrying alternating fortune — cycles of gain and loss rather than steady stability, though reliably cancelled by an angular Moon.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
